faq.a: Node.js 18+ (uses native test runner and modern TypeScript features). The template specifies Node 20 in Dockerfile and CI.

faq.q: Can I add Express/Fastify to this template?
faq.a: Yes. The template is a minimal TypeScript setup. Add your framework of choice after generation: `npm install express @types/express` or `npm install fastify`.

faq.q: Does it support ESM or CommonJS?
faq.a: ESM by default ("type": "module" in package.json). For CommonJS, change the package.json and tsconfig.json module settings.
